title: Technical Lead - AI
jobDescription:
Experience: 7+ years

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced and hands-on AI/ML Tech Lead to join our AI/ML team. This role demands a strong technical leader who can architect, guide, and deliver scalable AI solutions while actively contributing to code and model development. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in machine learning, computer vision, LLMs, and deployment practices, along with prior experience in leading and mentoring a team of engineers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of AI/ML models and API-based services across domains like Computer Vision, LLMs, and Agentic AI.

  • Guide and mentor a team of at least 4 AI/ML engineers, ensuring high-quality technical output and team growth.

  • Own infrastructure and DevOps decisions related to AI model serving, optimization, and monitoring.

  • Collaborate with DevOps, Data Engineering, and Product teams for seamless integration and delivery.

  • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI frameworks and tools to improve development velocity and model performance.

Required Skills:

  • 7+ years of experience in AI/ML, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership role guiding a team.

  • Proven hands-on experience in deploying production-grade ML models using Docker, FastAPI/Flask, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Deep understanding of version control (Git), containerization, and MLOps practices.

  • Proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, OpenCV, and HuggingFace/Transformers.

  • Exposure to agentic AI workflows, prompt engineering, and GPU-based training/inference.

  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and managing compute/GPU resources

title: Software Engineer - II
jobDescription:
We are looking for a skilled Oracle Fusion Consultant with 2 to 5 years of experience specializing in Order to Cash (O2C) and Invoice flows. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle APEX, and strong proficiency in PL/SQL and Oracle Database concepts. The candidate will play a critical role in supporting ongoing migration activities, improving system performance, and ensuring the stability and scalability of our ERP processes.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Analyze and understand existing migration activities, including customizations and integration flows.
  • Ensure system stability and data consistency across all modules and integrations.
  • Diagnose performance bottlenecks in Fusion, OIC integrations, and database processes; propose and implement optimizations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration-related issues and bugs efficiently.
  • Implement new enhancements and changes across Oracle Fusion, OIC, and APEX based on business needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for testing, deployment, and documentation of integration flows.


Required Skills & Qualifications.


  • 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion, specifically in Order to Cash (O2C) and Invoice modules.
  • In-depth understanding of Fusion O2C and Invoicing flows
  • Strong experience working with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for complex end-to-end integrations.
  • Should have worked in one end to end implementation project.
  • Hands-on-experience on BIP reports
  • Proficiency in Oracle APEX for custom UI development and backend logic.
  • Solid understanding of Oracle Database architecture and expertise in PL/SQL for writing and optimizing queries, procedures, and packages.
  • Experience in handling system performance tuning and debugging
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and in a team.

title: Senior Executive
jobDescription:
Job Title: Architectural Draughtsman (Retail Stores)

Experience: 5+ Years

Reporting To: Architect / Assistant Manager – Design

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled Architectural Draughtsman with strong experience in retail store design and execution drawings. The role involves preparing detailed architectural drawings,coordinating with design and execution teams, and ensuring accuracy and compliance with brand and technical standards.

Key Responsibilities

● Prepare detailed architectural drawings, layouts, and working drawings for retailstores (plans, elevations, sections, and details).

● Translate design concepts into accurate technical drawings using AutoCAD (orsimilar software).

● Support architects/design managers in developing store design solutions alignedwith brand guidelines.

● Develop Good for Construction (GFC) drawings and ensure timely delivery forproject execution.

● Coordinate with internal teams (design, project management) and externalconsultants/vendors.

● Review site measurements and incorporate site-specific conditions into drawings.● Maintain drawing standards, documentation, and version control.

● Assist in value engineering and optimization of design details.

● Ensure drawings comply with local building codes, regulations, and mall/landlordrequirements.

● Provide support during site execution for clarifications and revisions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

● Diploma in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Drafting, or Interior Design.● Minimum 3+ years of experience,preferably in retail/store design.

● Strong proficiency in AutoCAD (mandatory); knowledge of SketchUp/Revit is aplus.

● Good understanding of materials, construction details, and retail fixtures.● Ability to read and interpret architectural and MEP drawings.

● Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

● Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Experience

● Experience working on retail chains, mall stores, or high-street formats.● Exposure to fast-paced rollout projects and multi-location execution.● Familiarity with brand guideline-driven design systems.

Key Competencies

● Detail-oriented and organized

● Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously

● Problem-solving mindset

● Team collaboration

title: ML Engineer - II
jobDescription:
We are looking for a AI/ML Engineer to build and deploy scalable AI solutions across areas such as personalization, recommendation systems, forecasting, conversational AI, automation, and Generative AI applications. The role involves working closely with business and engineering teams to solve real-world problems using AI/ML technologies.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models for business use cases.
  • Build scalable ML and GenAI solutions using LLMs and modern AI frameworks.
  • Work on recommendation systems, NLP, forecasting, conversational AI, and automation.
  • Develop and optimize model training and inference pipelines.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business problems into AI solutions.
  • Mentor junior team members and drive engineering best practices.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, GenAI, and MLOps.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in AI/ML development.
  • Strong programming skills in Python.
  • Hands-on experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.
  • Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, and prompt engineering.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP.
  • Understanding of MLOps, model deployment, and scalable AI systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience in retail/e-commerce domain.
  • Exposure to recommendation systems and customer analytics.
  • Familiarity with tools/frameworks like LangChain, Hugging Face, MLflow, or Ollama.
  • Experience working with AI agents or automation frameworks.
